ELI5: Why version 536870919 and not version 4 for BitcoinXT blocks?

Because version 4 is already reserved for a softfork including BIP62 ( https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0062.mediawiki )

In hexadecimal it gives: 0x20000007 so it's just changing 2 bits. It kinda interferes with the version 4 deployment though: https://www.mail-archive.com/bitcoin-dev@lists.linuxfoundation.org/msg01473.html
